title: Signed strict Roos shifts descend through the prescribed localization
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with countable products and inverse limits of strict positive-integer towers $\mathcal T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\ge1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$, with levelwise exactness [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. Fix unbounded derived localizations $Q_T,Q_A$ with their integer shifts [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a tower complex $X$, put $P_X=\prod_nX_n$, $h_X=1-s_X$, where $\operatorname{pr}_ns_X=t_n\operatorname{pr}_{n+1}$, and $F(X)=\operatorname{Cone}(h_X)[-1]$ with the actual functor and inclusion $j_X:\lim X\to F(X)$ of [def-weil-strict-roos-model]. Its coordinates are $F(X)^i=P_X^{i-1}\oplus P_X^i$ with $d(y,x)=(-dy-h_Xx,dx)$; $F(f)$ acts diagonally by $\prod_nf_n$, and $j_X(z)=(0,z)$. Suppose a functor $G:D(\mathcal T)\to D(\mathcal A)$ and a natural isomorphism $\kappa_X:Q_AF(X)\xrightarrow{\sim}G(Q_TX)$ are given.

There is a coherent natural chain isomorphism $c_{X,r}:F(X[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}F(X)[r]$ whose coordinates are $(y,x)\mapsto((-1)^r y,x)$ and whose inverse has the same formula. It satisfies $c_{X,0}=1$ and $c_{X,r}[s]\circ c_{X[r],s}=c_{X,r+s}$. If $\lambda_{X,r}:\lim(X[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}(\lim X)[r]$ is identity on compatible tuples, then $c_{X,r}j_{X[r]}=j_X[r]\lambda_{X,r}$. There is a unique coherent natural shift comparison $\bar c_{N,r}:G(N[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}G(N)[r]$ such that
$$\bar c_{Q_TX,r}\circ\kappa_{X[r]}=\kappa_X[r]\circ Q_A(c_{X,r}),$$
with the canonical localization/shift identifications understood. This comparison is natural for every morphism in $D(\mathcal T)$, including inverses of quasi-isomorphisms, and makes the localized inclusion $Q_A(\lim X)\xrightarrow{Q_Aj_X}Q_AF(X)\xrightarrow{\kappa_X}G(Q_TX)$ commute with the specified termwise limit shift.

proof.text: Use lem-weil-product-comm-shift on the evaluation functors of the tower. Its projection formula identifies the product of the shifted tower with the shifted product. Projection extensionality proves that one minus the transition endomorphism commutes with this shift. Apply lem-weil-signed-mapping-cocone-shift to that endomorphism. Identify its arrow-map construction with the mappingCone.map construction in roosF, by the two cone inclusions, and transport the coherent shift through this natural identity-component isomorphism. The cocone inclusion formulas and its identity decomposition give the two projection-coordinate formulas. Composing with every tower product projection gives the forward formulas. Precompose the inverse formulas with the invertible forward shift map, then use the forward formulas and the identity (-1)^r squared equals one.

proof.text: Construct a cone for the diagram of level complexes using the complex obtained by applying the additive tower limit functor degreewise. Evaluation at each degree is the ordinary limiting cone, so it is a limit. The unique cone-point isomorphism identifies this degreewise model naturally with roosLimitFunctor. Transfer the standard shift structure of a functor applied degreewise across that isomorphism. Its limit projections give the asserted limit-shift formula. For the inclusion, first compare its product projections using that formula, then compare its two cocone coordinates: the product coordinate is the limit inclusion and the other is zero. The cocone identity decomposition proves the strict inclusion equation.

Its iso_hom_app formula followed by cancellation of the kappa and localization shift inverses gives the required factorization square.
